{{Quote|Unit 2-6, is that you?|07, moments before it is destroyed.|<ref name="rookies">{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}}</ref>}}
'''07''' was a [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commando]] who participated in the [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|Battle of the Rishi moon]].

==History==
{{Quote|Clones!|07's last word, as it realizes the trickery of Rex, before being shot in the head|<ref name="rookies" />}}
After [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] were presumed "pulverized," it and two other droid commandos, Units [[08/Legends|08]] and [[09/Legends|09]] guarded the entrance to the station. It was surprised to see [[Unit 26/Legends|Unit 26]] still alive, only to find out too late that, instead of Unit 26, it was Cody and Rex, who were still alive.

The droid opened the [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]] and was blasted by Rex, leading the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] right into the base.
